candidates.instruction: Create the distinctive feminine voice of a young adult heroine in a Japanese fantasy anime, speaking clear English. A delicate, bell-clear tone with warmth underneath, musical phrasing and expressive little changes at phrase endings. The voice belongs to an animated heroine, not a live-action child. Thank you is gently reserved; What are you doing here reveals sudden concern; The little girl trails into a worried thought. Keep one recognizable voice throughout. Brief pauses between sentences; speak only the supplied words.
